Buttons and time slots

Every pressable scales to 0.96 on press - one value across the whole app. Primary clears 4.6:1 for white text; secondary carries a full-weight border rather than a tint.

Time slots

A slot taken while you are looking at it is struck through and labelled, never silently removed - the disappearance is the thing the user has to believe.

A slot the standby queue won has to read as neither open nor taken, or the one moment the queue exists for passes unnoticed.
